issues.reason: Compound concepts states the head genus "is always emitted either way" and makes the modifier genus an addition to it rather than a substitute, and the IS-A suppression escape does not apply because "snap" independently denotes a brief spell of weather, so the missing (Inheritance cold_snap snap) is a real omission of a mandated atom.

A continuative aspectual matrix verb is genuinely uncovered (the reviewer's own gap), and the Inception template — reify the aspectual verb, Theme = the activity's own witness marked Ongoing — is the nearest licensed analogue, so (Ongoing sk_distribute_1) is true of "continued to distribute" and well-typed, which the calibration line makes acceptable improvisation rather than a defect; "continue" is an aspectual verb like "begin", not one of the volitional control verbs the no-status rule lists.

"No lantern on the Cliff Path" names a restricted kind, so the negative-universal rule must range over (Member $x lantern) with the restriction as a premise conjunct (the adjectivally-restricted-kind-subject rule); ranging over (PartOf $x sk_lanterns_1) silently swaps the stated restriction for membership in a previously-introduced set — barred by Core patterns' "a stated restriction is never silently dropped" — and leaves the (QuantifierPhrase lantern go_out "no") companion naming a range the rule does not quantify.

The text states "on the Cliff Path" of the keepers and inside the quantified "no lantern" NP, never of the keepers' lanterns as a group, so the strength-1.0 (On sk_lanterns_1 cliff_path) asserts an unstated location, which Core patterns bars ("no unstated property, possessor, location or causal link, however obvious").

gaps_confirmed: No form for a continuative aspectual matrix verb ("continued to V"): Inception and cessation each get an explicit template, continuation of an ongoing activity gets none, and the nearest carriers (Still, and the inceptive's Ongoing) are each defined for other constructions.

A relative-offset temporal adjunct with an unnamed anchor ("ended after three nights") has no licensed form — BeforeBy needs two eventualities, and only deictic "ago / from now" gets the reserved now anchor — so the extent can only be re-read as the eventuality's own duration Measure.
new_gaps: QuantifierPhrase has no slot for a restricted range: when the rule ranges over a restricted kind ("no lantern on the Cliff Path"), the companion (QuantifierPhrase lantern go_out "no") can only name the bare kind, which is broader than the range the rule actually quantifies — the instruction set requires the companion to restate exactly the rule's range.
defect_summary: cold_snap must carry its head genus (Inheritance cold_snap snap) beside the modifier genus; "No lantern on the Cliff Path went out that night" must be a single strength-0.0 rule ranging over (And (Member $x lantern) (On $x cliff_path)) with no group-level denial over the keepers' lantern group; and (On sk_lanterns_1 cliff_path) must simply not be emitted, the restriction living only as that rule's premise conjunct.
notes: The Ongoing atom is the one issue I refute — "continued to V" is genuinely uncovered and the inceptive template is the closest licensed analogue. The three confirmed issues after the genus omission share one root: the quantified "no lantern on the Cliff Path" was resolved to the keepers' lantern group from sentence 1 instead of being treated as a restricted kind.
